nodes.description: Public constant uint256 price multiplier (1e10) used to scale Chainlink's 8-decimal answer to 18 decimals.
State variable of type AggregatorInterface holding the address of the adapted Chainlink aggregator contract.
ChainlinkOracleAdapter constructor; receives the aggregator interface and stores it in the oracle state variable.
External view function that reads the Chainlink aggregator answer, casts it to uint256 and multiplies it by PRICE_MULTIPLIER.
SafeMath internal pure helper performing checked multiplication of two uint256 values (returns 0 when a == 0, requires c / a == b otherwise).
External call to the untrusted aggregator contract oracle.latestAnswer(); its int256 return value is trusted and coerced to uint256.
Arithmetic operation uint256 c = a * b inside SafeMath.mul, with a subsequent division-based overflow check.
Constructor parameter of type AggregatorInterface; the aggregator address being adapted.
Local variable in read() holding the uint256-cast output of the Chainlink aggregator.
Local variable in SafeMath.mul holding the product a * b.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _oracle is assigned into the oracle state variable.
Constructor writes the oracle state variable (state initialization by deployment-time input).
read() loads the oracle state variable to invoke the aggregator.
The oracle state variable is the target of the external latestAnswer() call.
read() performs the external call oracle.latestAnswer() and uses its result.
Return value of the external latestAnswer() call is cast to uint256 and stored in oracleOutput.
oracleOutput is passed as the first argument into SafeMath.mul.
PRICE_MULTIPLIER is read inside read() as the scaling factor.
read() invokes the SafeMath.mul library function to apply the price multiplier.
SafeMath.mul executes the multiplication a * b, the arithmetic operation under analysis.
First operand a flows into the multiplication operation.
Second operand b flows into the multiplication operation.
Result of a * b is stored in local variable c before the overflow check.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _oracle is a non-core input that is only used to initialize the oracle state variable inside the constructor; it can be folded into the constructor core function.
oracleOutput is a temporary local of read() that merely carries the external call result into the multiplication; it can be merged into the read core function.
Parameter a is a purely internal operand of the SafeMath.mul core function with no independent identity.
Parameter b is a purely internal operand of the SafeMath.mul core function with no independent identity.
Local variable c is the immediate result holder of the multiplication unsafe_operation and can be merged into that arithmetic node.
